journeys.title: Server: install from the real package (Windows service) and sign in
Installer failure: a damaged Setup.exe installs nothing and says so
Client installation through the installer window, proven by Windows
First run: sign in through the window, the agent connects to the server
FULL CHAIN: backup set in the window -> Back up now -> delete the source -> Restore in the window -> SHA-256
Service restart: Windows restarts the backup service, then backup and restore again
Agent crash mid-backup: the process is killed; Windows brings it back; no ghost run; the next backup restores identical
Service stopped mid-backup: the run ends cleanly; start; backup and restore identical
